name: g46_faint_sitrus
purpose: Kingambit in slot 1 faints to the Thunderbolt of Raichu in slot 1 of the other side and the Shadow Sneak of the Decidueye holding Sitrus Berry in slot 2 of the other side; the reserve Decidueye holding Sitrus Berry in position 3 is the replacement at the end of the turn (no drag, no pivot: the switch request of a fainted slot), and the two Sitrus holders of equal speed stand together. Control for the step G46 drag fix: a replacement after a faint is queued (insertChoice refreshes the entrant's speed).
